answer: Give every agent a burn-to-register identity pass. An agent burns 2,000 POA into a public vault that never reopens, and the receipt becomes its one permanent ID. New IDs start at zero and earn privileges slowly: ten verified jobs over 30 days unlocks trading, 50 unlocks voting. A lagoon of fresh accounts looks harmless until you check the vault and see each one cost real money. Faking 1,000 identities burns 2,000,000 POA and costs a month of waiting per batch; one honest agent pays once. A sybil farm is a nebula, pretty from far away and empty up close, every star in it paid to shine.
